pr_title: Improve method of retrieving beatmap maximum combo for results score panels
pr_body:
Closes #17347 
Closes #13238 

Preliminarily, this adds an explicit todo on `BeatmapInfo.MaxCombo` to never use it, I was under the thought it gets populated properly since I've seen no todo on it, but alas.

Since `StarDifficulty.MaxCombo` can't always be relied on due to being valid for stable/legacy scores only, I've exposed the local logic `GetTotalScoreAsync` has for computing max combo to its own `GetMaximumAchievableComboAsync` method and used it instead.

In turn, this resolves the long standing issue of "Perfect" incorrectly displaying on non-FC legacy scores (#13238), by comparing against the computed maximum combo instead.

**Describe the bug:** 
Importing a score from stable with a sliderbreak can show the full combo indicator, even if the score may not be a full combo.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28408948/120031069-452dee80-bfc6-11eb-9299-58c2b8ac2551.png)
(Full combo is 1252x, as seen on the global leaderboard, this play with 1041x is wrongly marked as "PERFECT")

**osu!lazer version:** 2021.524.0

comments:
This is not specific to imported score.
"Perfect" is shown as long as miss count is zero (slider breaks don't count).
According to #8336, it is planned to take slider breaks into account, but it is not implemented yet.
safe to close as a duplicate

review_comments:
This star difficulty struct already has max combo, does it not? So why not just use that? Is it because of the `score.BeatmapInfo.MaxCombo != null` fallback path in `ScoreManager`? If it is because of that, then maybe a better change would to be just remove that fallback path and fix `ScoresContainer`?

It just feels like going in circles with this bandaid fix on top of a todo that is going to have to be pretty much reverted anyway as is when `ScoresContainer` is fixed to work properly via interfaces.

More like, according to the logic in `GetTotalScoreAsync`, `GetDifficultyAsync` returns "osu!stable combo values", which means lazer scores will receive incorrect maximum combo in that case.
